subject: CaspianPay discovery — spend pathway & pilot sizing recap
messages:
From: Sasha Roman <sasha@caspianpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Jones <tim.jones@caspianpay.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — CaspianPay

Hannah — thanks again for today. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned: 

- Primary pain: spike costs when customers use the concierge chat during onboarding flows (short sessions but very high concurrency during launches).
- Current volume: ~180k API calls / month across prod + staging; peak concurrency ~220 sessions during marketing pushes.
- Budget constraint: finance has a firm cap for pilot spend: $8k/month for inference. Any initial ask above that needs exec approval.
- Goals: reduce per-session cost by 30% without noticeable latency regression; evaluate caching/batching plus a short Dedicated pilot.

I attached a small sample of session traces (CaspianPay-usage-sample.csv) for token distribution. Happy to run another call if you need different slices.

—Sasha
Product Lead, CaspianPay

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Roman <sasha@caspianpay.com>
Cc: Tim Jones <tim.jones@caspianpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — CaspianPay

Sasha — great meeting, thanks for the extra data. Quick internal + external recap and proposed next steps so we can stay concise for finance and your engineering leads: 

Summary of key constraints and opportunity
- Short, bursty sessions dominate token distribution: median session 42 tokens, tail up to ~2.5k for escalation flows.
- Your sample shows a high repeat prefix across sessions (welcome script + legal notice) — this is ideal for prefix/KV caching.
- Finance cap: $8k/mo for pilot; our objective is to show a path to 30%+ cost reduction at that spend level or identify a narrowly scoped pilot that proves the savings.

Redwood levers and rough impact estimates (first-order)- Prefix/KV cache: for repeated welcome + FAQ content, expect 25–40% token spend reduction if hit rates are >=55%.- Aggressive batching at 100–200ms window: 10–18% savings for concurrent spikes without adding significant P95 tail if latency SLOs are set correctly.- Quantization (int8) on a Dedicated pilot node: 8–12% additional per-token CPU/GPU saving in inference cost, with light impact on high-sensitivity outputs — recommend run with golden prompt checks.

Proposed pilot structure (6 weeks)
1) Week 0–1: onboarding + SOW + telemetry hook (span tags, token-level tracing).
2) Week 2–4: run hybrid hosted + dedicated cadence: enable prefix cache + batching on a subset of traffic (10–20%) to measure real hit rates and latency impact.
3) Week 5–6: scale to 50% traffic and produce final ROI report.

Commit ask for pilot given your constraint:
- Redwood provides a staggered pricing pilot: $6k/mo baseline for hosting + dedicated buffer, with shared instrumentation and up to two dedicated nodes for the test window. Estimate total pilot spend ~ $9k for the first full month because of setup/telemetry — we can cover $1k as a one-time engineering credit if you can commit to a 6-week pilot.

Next actions- Sasha/Tom: confirm whether the $6k/month baseline + $1k credit structure is acceptable to finance.
- Ben: can you prepare a SOW draft and an instrumentation checklist by EOD Tuesday?
- Marissa: I’ll coordinate the scheduling with your infra lead to set the cutover guardrails.

If that structure works, I’ll send a short SOW and a measurement plan this afternoon.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pilot-SOW-draft.pdf (prelim)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Roman <sasha@caspianpay.com>, Tim Jones <tim.jones@caspianpay.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — CaspianPay

Hannah / team — Draft SOW is attached (see redwood-pilot-SOW-draft.pdf). Highlights I added:
- Measurement hooks: per-session token burn, KV-cache hit rate, P50/P95 latency before/after, and error rates per endpoint.
- Success criteria: cost reduction >= 25% at 30% traffic with no P95 latency regression > 20%.
- Rollback plan: immediate disable of batching and cache if error rate increases >0.5% or latency exceeds guarded thresholds.

Ben — one note on the pricing ask: we can flex the one-time credit to $1.5k if they sign a 3-month engagement after pilot (standard upsell path). Recommend keeping that optionality visible to Sasha to unblock finance.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sasha Roman <sasha@caspianpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Jones <tim.jones@caspianpay.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — CaspianPay

Thanks — this looks reasonable. Two quick clarifications from finance/engineering: 
1) Finance confirmed a strict pilot cap of $8k total for month 1 (they prefer to keep the one-time setup under vendor credits rather than line-item). If Redwood can accept $6k/mo with a maximum $2k setup exposure (credit or billed), we’re green.
2) Engineering asks that cache TTLs be editable per route and that we have a safe button to drop KV cache quickly if stale content is observed. They’d like a short playbook for emergency rollback.

We’re fine to proceed if you can update the SOW with the $8k hard cap and the TTL/editability callouts. Tim and I can provide a small sample of high-concurrency session IDs if that helps tune batching windows.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sasha
